stem: Harbor Steel keeps factory control systems on premises for regulation and wants the same AWS APIs used in its cloud workloads.

choices.text: AWS Local Zones in the nearest metro area
AWS Wavelength Zones at telecom edge locations
AWS Outposts in the factory datacenter
Amazon EC2 Dedicated Hosts in a public Region

rationale: AWS Outposts extends AWS infrastructure and APIs into on-premises facilities for consistent hybrid operations. Local Zones and Wavelength are AWS-managed edge locations, not in-facility deployments. Dedicated Hosts in a public Region remain cloud-resident and do not satisfy the on-premises placement requirement.
